metrics.certificate_note: certificate.kind: none, EXPLICITLY. This control computes no discrete logarithm and collects no relation, so there is no solve or relation claim to certify (docs/claims-and-verification.md). Its reproduction gate, its per-replicate geometry-invariance assertions and its closed-form applicability assertions are internal consistency checks, not certificates, and are reported as such.
metrics.scope: Tier TOY. Instrument characterisation only. No ECDLP claim, no cost or exponent claim, sota_delta zero.

raw.curve_id: n/a (control on four frozen pools; no curve is re-enumerated and no functional is re-measured)

decision.asymmetry_declared: state_1 (CONTROLLED_NULL) is a POSITIVE finding about the INSTRUMENT and state_2 (STRUCTURE_PRESENT) is NOT a finding about mathematics. Neither outcome supports any GOAL-ENDO-001 hypothesis. A `p > 0.05` result means NO STRUCTURE DETECTED AT 200 REPLICATES, never 'no structure exists': the resolution floor is 1/201 = 0.004975 and the design's power against a small effect is not characterised.
decision.denominator_used_by_the_decision_rule: THE COUNT, over the full 144-cell frame. The frozen statistic is a COUNT and the null is drawn over the same 144-cell frame, so the denominator does not enter the p-value at all. 50 reproduces under BOTH denominators because the six-cell difference is cells with no defined R at any rung, which cannot be in the residue under either. Both fractions are reported.
decision.evidence_strength_cap: Any evidence record arising from this control is capped at `preliminary` and `claim_tier: toy` regardless of outcome. Under AGENTS.md rule 12 the contradiction between a validated execution report and an independent review already requires further independent review before ANY evidence record is written from this line of work.
decision.frozen_decision_rule_statistic: Two-sided empirical p-value of the observed type-A residue count in the shuffled null, computed as (1 + #{replicates at least as extreme}) / (1 + n_replicates), extremeness measured as |x - median(null)|.
